# Total Wireless

> Total Wireless offers no-contract prepaid wireless plans with 5G coverage, home internet, and device options from major manufacturers.

Total Wireless is a prepaid wireless carrier providing unlimited talk, text, and data plans on Verizon's 5G network, along with home internet service and a rewards loyalty program. The site supports both English and Spanish-language customers.

## Key Topics

- 5G prepaid wireless plans
- Unlimited talk/text/data
- Home internet service
- No contracts, no fees
- Bring Your Own Phone (BYOP)
- eSIM activation
- Total Rewards loyalty program
- Smartphone devices (Apple, Samsung, Motorola, TCL)
- Mobile hotspot plans
- Tablet data plans
- Total Wireless Protect
- Verizon network coverage
- Service activation
- Device compatibility
- Account management

## Plans & Pricing

- [Shop Prepaid Phone Plans: No Contracts, No Fees](https://www.totalwireless.com/m/plans): Prepaid plans: unlimited talk/text/data, 5G, no contracts
- [Unlimited Prepaid Phone Plans](https://www.totalwireless.com/m/plans/smartphone): Unlimited smartphone plans with Verizon 5G coverage
- [Fast and Reliable 5G Home Internet Plan](https://www.totalwireless.com/m/plans/home-internet): 5G home internet: unlimited data, $45 first month
- [Shop Data plans for Hotspots](https://www.totalwireless.com/m/plans/mobile-hotspot): Hotspot data plans: 15GB-100GB on Verizon 5G network
- [Shop Unlimited Prepaid Tablet Plans](https://www.totalwireless.com/m/plans/tablet): Unlimited tablet data plans with bundle savings

## Devices & Shopping

- [Browse Phones](https://www.totalwireless.com/buy/phones): Browse phones from Apple, Samsung, Motorola, TCL, BLU
- [Smartphone Catalog](https://www.totalwireless.com/buy/smartphones): Smartphone catalog: Apple, Samsung, Motorola, TCL
- [Basic Phones](https://www.totalwireless.com/buy/basic-phones): Basic phones: TCL FLIP 3 and budget mobile devices
- [Phone Accessories](https://www.totalwireless.com/buy/accessories): Phone accessories: cases, chargers, earbuds, protectors

## Activation & Setup

- [Switch to Total Wireless & Activate Your Service Today](https://www.totalwireless.com/activation): Activate service: no contracts, flexible plans, device setup
- [Bring your Own Phone (BYOP) or Device (BYOD)](https://www.totalwireless.com/byop): BYOP program guide: bring device, activate, save with 5G
- [Activate eSIM on Total Wireless - How eSIM Works](https://www.totalwireless.com/esim): eSIM activation guide: compatible devices, setup steps

## Customer Support & Account

- [Customer Service Support and Help](https://www.totalwireless.com/support): Customer support hub: FAQs, troubleshooting, contact options
- [My Rewards](https://www.totalwireless.com/my-account/my-rewards): Total Rewards loyalty program dashboard and account management
- [Self-Service Help via SMS](https://dsweb.totalwireless.com/611611/help): Self-service help via SMS keywords and account management
- [Find A Total Wireless Store or National Retailer Nearest You](https://www.totalwireless.com/stores): Store locator for Total Wireless locations and national retailers
